# Menu 225 (shift lip frames) on inputs/face4.pmx with swing600.vmd, whose
# keys of あ (frames 50, 150, 300, 450) land on face4's UV morph あ, the one
# morph of kind 3: -100 drops the key at 50, then +25 shifts the rest.
load model face4.pmx
load vmd swing600.vmd
shift lip -100
save pmm shift-back.pmm
select all morph
save vmd shift-back.vmd
shift lip 25
save pmm shift-forward.pmm
select all morph
save vmd shift-forward.vmd
